title: Niagara-on-the-Lake Wine Tour with Lunch
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: An authentic wine-tasting expedition awaits in a small group setting that is unique, fun, and engaging led by Niagara’s best and most knowledgeable industry professional wine tour guides. During this unique journey through wine country, you will learn how grapes are cultivated, the proper techniques of tasting wine, what to look for in a quality wine, the history of the Niagara wine region, its wineries, and the various wines produced in this region. Lunch included.
